steps.description: Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Make a well in the center and pour in milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Whisk until just combined — lumps are fine. Don't overmix.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat. Add a small knob of butter.
Pour a ladle of batter (about ¼ cup per pancake). Cook until bubbles form on surface.
Flip and cook until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes more.
